objective: Obtain the required front/left/right sharp, verified photographs promptly; measure completion and work before completion separately from whole-video throughput.
decision: Ship recovery only after a failed replacement of an already verified pending shot. The broad new-visit recovery was rejected after a fixed-input clarity regression. Quality ranking, all thresholds, models and lock windows remain unchanged.

mechanism.same_visit: Original candidate_retry_s backoff after hard failure.
mechanism.new_visit: One eligible, improving candidate can recover early after the classified view changes or breaks then returns.
mechanism.continuous_failures: Failure consumes the early recovery until the wait expires; repeated pose flicker cannot mint a new token.
mechanism.verified_pass: Clears backoff so original consecutive temporal evidence can accumulate.
mechanism.scope: Per track; reset with its context. Only the landmarker video candidate path uses this gate.
mechanism.eligibility: A hard failure must occur while the same view has a verified pending shot. Ordinary initial acquisition failures keep original backoff, even if the pose changes.

method.screening: Six full-input policy replays per video on b20efa3, exact-input model memoization keyed by model SHA, threshold, tensor shape/dtype/bytes SHA. Counts are logical forward calls. Cached screening durations are deliberately not reported.
method.bounded_replay: All 2526 frames through production bounded recovery. Every logical forward was an actual cache miss; recorded SHA is unencoded aligned-pixel bytes. No timing from this instrumented run is used.
method.realtime: Serial baseline A / bounded A / bounded B / baseline B; B reverses video order. Original PTS, latest-frame queue capacity 1, ORT 4 threads, 1000 us spin/backoff 8, OpenCV 1 thread, HighQoS verified, 15 warmups/model. No heavy validation runs concurrently; external OS load/frequency not locked. All eight runs retained.
method.baseline_loading: Same benchmark/milestone recorder and model adapters; only old engine/refiner imported. All other existing Python package modules are AST-identical; config differences are comments, several file hashes differ only in newlines. Not full-package isolation.
method.counter_distinction: Offline screen counts model._run forward calls. Existing real-time benchmark model_calls counts model.detect API calls, including any early-return call.
method.first_complete: Inference-thread snapshot of the active primary track after process(): video/wall time, processed frames, summed processing time, model calls and selected frame IDs. Full replay then continues for jitter measurement. Existing camera/H5 auto-stop behavior was not introduced here.
method.pooled: Percentiles recomputed from concatenated per-frame values, not averaged trial percentiles. FPS is total processed frames / total elapsed.
